title: A watcher that refuses a red merge, into any branch, without waiting for anyone to look
goal: Two scripts, needing only node and gh. One reports the check state of every open pull request and exits non-zero when any is red, so it runs one-shot or inside a polling monitor. The other guards one pull request before merge and refuses unless every check passed, whatever its base branch, so a stacked merge is held to the same bar as main. Branch protection guards only main, and it is off; this depends on neither it nor anyone noticing.
acceptance: Given an open pull request with a failing check, when scripts/ci-watch.mjs runs, then it names the pull request, the failing check and its run link, and exits non-zero
Given every open pull request is green, when scripts/ci-watch.mjs runs, then it exits zero
Given a pull request with a pending, failing, cancelled or skipped check, when scripts/pre-merge-check.mjs is run for it, then it refuses and names what is not green
Given a pull request whose base is not main and whose checks all pass, when scripts/pre-merge-check.mjs runs for it, then it allows the merge and states the base branch
Given a check reported as skipped, when either script runs, then it is treated as not passed rather than as a pass

reviews.summary: Pass with 1 medium finding open. PERF-01: one GitHub call per pull request and a full job log per failing check — forced by gh, bounded by open PR count, but the shape the rule names. TEST-01 now holds: the scripts were made importable at 093a231 so the ERROR-on-failure, wrong-shape and keep-going paths are asserted with a fake runner rather than proven by hand.

Pass, nothing open. SEC-30 holds — every gh call passes arguments as a list with no shell, and both outside values are digits-only before use, now with ten abuse tests proving each refusal happens before gh is called at all. SEC-06 checks gh's output shape as well as the command line. No secret, no personal data, nothing shipped to a device.

Pass. All five acceptance criteria hold, each proven by a test that fails without the behaviour. Two could not be demonstrated against the real repository at all, which is why the scripts were made importable. TEST-09 satisfied deliberately: letting skipping count as a pass failed two tests at both levels, and removing the argument guard failed all ten abuse cases; both restored, 59 green. Nothing extra was built.

Pass with 1 high finding open, pre-existing rather than caused here: nothing audits dependencies on change or on a schedule, and 18 vulnerabilities are present (2 critical), all dev-only. Re-checked at 093a231 after further commits — package.json still adds only two npm scripts, the lockfile still has no diff at all, and nothing of this change ships.
